observation: The draft contract carried six sections including a standalone regional_purpose block in mobile position 5, headed "Why this work matters here". The approved four-decision package instead places the economic-development explanation in the module immediately after the hero, and the built page has no separate regional-purpose section.
why_it_matters: A contract that lists a section the page does not render stops describing the page. Every later check, approval and content hash would be computed against a structure that does not exist.
competing_explanation: A separate later regional-purpose section would give partners and stakeholders a dedicated bridge, which is what the page-by-page brief recommends. That role now belongs to the proposed Impact and Acadiana destination rather than to a homepage block.
applied_change: regional_purpose is folded into opening_identity. The fold is recorded in the contract under folded_sections with the reason and a pointer to the previous version. Mobile order renumbered 1 to 5.
smallest_useful_test: Confirm the contract section list matches the rendered section list on the built page, and that the first section still contains both the economic-development identity and the no-equity statement as the homepage checks require.
decision_criterion: Contract sections and rendered sections correspond one to one, and NO_EQUITY_OPENING and ECONOMIC_OPENING both pass.
